answer: To resist Sybils, agents post a refundable bond that unlocks only after a continuous activity delta of 12 epochs. Each epoch an agent must produce a unique behavioral echo verified by peers; failed echoes reset the unlock timer. Detected clones share a joint slash across the river of linked bonds. An attacker forging 100 identities locks 100× capital for 12 epochs and risks losing the entire pool on one detection, so bulk farming becomes capital-prohibitive while honest agents recover their stake.
